data.gender_notes: Jodi is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Jodah means 'God knows' or 'judgment'. In Greek, Iodice means 'violet-colored' or 'purple one'. Both meanings contribute to the Jodi name, symbolizing God's divine judgment and His gift to the world. The name Jodi carries the meaning “Judgment, God's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jodi usually hope their child will grow to embody judgment, god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Τζόδι
in_greek.meaning: Δωρεά του Θεού και αντανάκλαση χαράς
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Τζόδι είναι μορφή της ονομασίας Ιούδα ή Ιουδή, που σημαίνει 'Δωρεά του Θεού' και συνδέεται με την έννοια της χαράς και της ευγνωμοσύνης. Στην παράδοση των ονομάτων της Εκκλησίας, το Τζόδι αντανακλά την πνευματική χαρά και την προσήλωση στον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Jodi
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Jodi ex Hebraeo 'Yod' vel 'Judah' derivatur, quod 'Dei donum' seu 'confessio' significat. In traditione Christiana, Jodi personam gaudii et devotionis ad Deum repraesentat, quae in primis communitatibus Christianis usitata erat.
